status: Fixed field semantics before implementation/control/country profile
input: Existing audited graph/paid geometry, one resolved modeled-road position and separately named paid connector initialTicks; no fake oversized partial-arc cost or new road transfer.
search: Bounded incoming-arc Dijkstra, unchanged signal/barrier/forbidden-turn/exact-reverse rules. Initial true vertex can depart under existing source semantics; interior source seeds only actual enabled directions. Source connector cost is added once before remaining road cost. Maximum horizon 345600 ticks (12h).
labels: One uint32 per directed arc. 0xffffffff=unreached. Values <0x80000000 are fully paid head-arrival ticks <=horizon. Values 0x80000000+entryTicks record legal tail entry when the full head is beyond horizon; these frontier records are never queued as head arrivals. Saturate by the horizon before any uint32 sum/write.
partialSourceShadow: At most two source-seeded arcs retain an additional minimum regular tail-entry tick. A cheap source suffix can dominate the head label while a later legitimate loop reaches the arc's prefix; retain both the source suffix and the regular prefix without making the interval between them reachable for free. Source-position rank, not quantized time alone, decides which side of a seed can be reached.
vertexSummary: Uint16 upward whole-second arrival summary, sentinel65535; routing decisions never use it. Only reached vertices are written. It may overstate arrival by <=7 ticks, so display-position values are upper bounds rather than exact vertex ETA. Production minute thresholds are whole seconds.
positionArrival: Minimum of regular prefix entry plus independently upward priced portion, eligible source suffix/direct portion and actual endpoint arrival summary. Preserve one-way directions and source rank through loops/backtracking/quantized flat prefixes. No label-derived negative or free upstream entry on a seeded arc.
limits: 40m settles, 1m heap entries, explicit callbacks/deadline; no country objects, incoming map, predecessor array or all-origin cache. Returned field arrays are per-query scratch and must be released after display output; they are not added to retained engine data.
controlsBeforeCountryProfile: Frontier arcs with unreachable heads still expose paid reachable prefixes
Cheap partial seed plus later regular-prefix loop leaves any unpaid gap unreachable
Zero/full quantized internal prefixes do not become junctions
Independent qualified pair-search comparisons for all generated vertices/positions, retaining unreachable cases
Horizon/source cost/heap/settle/refusal and uint32 maximum full-arc overflow
notAdmitted: Complete app, final query scratch across phases, packaged startup, function/retained or Vercel gates
